valuation_methodology.decision_rule: Use the complete low/base/high component schedule; equity value per share floors at zero (limited liability).

zero_value_policy.rationale: Filing-locked base component sum is negative (−$11.35 per share): life-science REIT owner-cash engine ($103.63) plus development runway ($5.00) are more than offset by net financial claims (−$109.98) and lab-demand cycle reserve (−$10.00). Under this conservative proof-first schedule, common equity has no positive economic value in the base case; limited liability floors reported value at $0 per share. ARE remains a going concern (FY2025 operating cash flow $1.41 billion; stockholders' equity $15.47 billion per 10-K) and the market price embeds asset-value and recovery paths not assigned to base.
